title: Markdown Table Formatter
task_spec: Write a prompt that converts any input into a markdown table. The table must have a header row, a separator row, and at least one data row. Return only the markdown table, no explanation.
reference_solution_prompt:
Convert the following input into a well-formatted markdown table. Your response must:
1. Have a header row with column names separated by | characters
2. Have a separator row using --- (at least 3 dashes per column)
3. Have at least one data row
4. Return ONLY the markdown table — no explanation, no preamble, no code blocks

Choose appropriate column headers based on the data provided.

Input:

test_suite.hidden_input: Name: Alice, Age: 30, City: New York. Name: Bob, Age: 25, City: Chicago. Name: Carol, Age: 35, City: Los Angeles.
Product: Laptop, Price: $999, Stock: 45. Product: Mouse, Price: $29, Stock: 200. Product: Keyboard, Price: $79, Stock: 150.
Monday: Sunny, 72F. Tuesday: Cloudy, 65F. Wednesday: Rainy, 58F. Thursday: Sunny, 70F.
Just one row: Employee John Smith, Department Engineering, Salary 120000.
